tools.name: status
tools.description: Show this code-share instance's URLs, tunnel state, shared projects, and connected peers.

tools.name: share
tools.description: Add a local git repo to the shared scope so peers can fetch it read-only.

repoPath.description: Filesystem path to the git repo to share

name.description: Name to serve the repo under (default: directory basename)

leader.description: Mark this side as leader for this project (default false)

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Pull-only sync of a shared project from a connected peer (never pushes); returns the resulting ahead/behind state.

project.description: Project name to sync (omit if exactly one project is shared)

useRebase.description: Use rebase instead of merge (default false)
